title: My Birthday and My Favourite Month
text:
My birthday is in May. It is on the fifteenth of May. In my country, May is a spring month. The weather is warm and nice in May.

My favourite month is July. We have a holiday in July. We go to the sea with my family. July has thirty-one days.

questions.text: What is the writer's favourite month?
What kind of weather does the writer probably enjoy?
Why does the writer feel happy about July?
options: There is a holiday and the family goes to the sea
It is the coldest month of the year
It is a short month with only ten days
It is the month of the writer's birthday

vocabulary.definition: the day of the year when a person was born
the season between winter and summer
the condition of the air outside, such as warm, cold, or rainy
a period of time when you do not work or go to school, for rest or travel

paragraph_translations: Moje urodziny są w maju. Są piętnastego maja. W moim kraju maj to miesiąc wiosenny. Pogoda w maju jest ciepła i przyjemna.
Mój ulubiony miesiąc to lipiec. W lipcu mamy wakacje. Jeździmy nad morze z rodziną. Lipiec ma trzydzieści jeden dni.
